about: Hotel Lobby as our crew performs it: everything a version with other characters is made from. Each shot has the performers' motion (body keypoints, and the skeleton rebuilt for the build below and laid out for the 9:16 frame), its first frame with the crew, and its prompt with each role's slot ({Lead} is that role's name and look, {Pair} who the two are, {PartnerName} the partner's name). The takes run shot-swap-dev.json with the pose as a ready-made control and the vocals frozen in.

sound.note: The trend's own song: the vocals drive the lip sync, the mix goes under the cut. It is the original recording, so it is replaced or removed before the repository is published.

roles.look: a cute small fluffy caramel-orange and cream kitten with a big round head, big amber eyes, a pink nose, a yellow collar with a small gold bell and short little arms with round paws
a cute small plush black kitten with a big round head, vivid green eyes, a small cream chest tuft and short little arms with round paws

shots.prompt: Vertical wide shot of {Pair} standing upright on an orange stage, in front of a seamless orange backdrop in soft even studio light, a slim silver studio microphone hanging down between them at their head height. A yellow floor runs along the bottom. On the left, {Lead}, looks down at the front paws and rubs them together. On the right, {Partner}, raps with a paw at the mouth. Both stand upright and groove to a laid-back trap beat, in a polished 3D animated feature-film style. Clear male rap vocals, close to the microphone.

Both stand upright and groove to a laid-back trap beat, in a polished 3D animated feature-film style. Clear male rap vocals, close to the microphone.
